prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Edit target: the supplied 4-column by 3-row twelve zodiac starfield atlas.
User revision: each tile needs a clear corresponding ZODIAC FIGURATIVE ILLUSTRATION in addition to the stars and constellation lines. Star dots alone are not sufficient.
Preserve: same exact 4x3 equal-cell edge-to-edge grid, same Aries-to-Pisces order, square individual cells, elegant indigo/lavender/rose nebula backgrounds and gentle starry atmosphere. Keep corresponding luminous connected star diagrams visible as a subtle secondary layer. Retain quiet cell edges, and no figure or star line may cross into the adjacent tile.
ADD one beautiful, instantly recognizable symbolic illustration in the center of EACH of the twelve cells. Style is elegant silver-gold celestial engraving mixed with translucent luminous painted illustration: fine glowing contours, soft translucent pearlescent body shading, ethereal stardust, magical but refined, NOT flat glyphs, NOT emoji, NOT chibi or cartoon stickers. Make figures clearly readable even at a 90px thumbnail: figures should have stronger visual priority than the nebula, visible silhouettes and enough body shading to recognize them. Constellation points and lines may float gently across or around the figure without obscuring it. No abstract substitute for the requested figure.
Exact order left to right:
ROW ONE:
1 ARIES: a graceful white ram in side profile, complete body and clearly curling horns.
2 TAURUS: a strong but elegant bull with visible long horns, clearly different from the ram.
3 GEMINI: two graceful matching adult twin human figures together, both fully clothed in simple flowing celestial robes, distinct paired silhouettes.
4 CANCER: a symmetrical crab with two obvious claws and multiple slender legs.
ROW TWO:
5 LEO: a majestic lion in profile with an abundant luminous mane and curved tail.
6 VIRGO: a graceful adult maiden in a flowing fully covering gown holding a small sheaf of wheat; refined and serene.
7 LIBRA: a beautiful balanced weighing scale, central upright and two clearly separated hanging bowls.
8 SCORPIO: an elegant scorpion with visible pincers and a long curled segmented tail/stinger.
ROW THREE:
9 SAGITTARIUS: a graceful celestial centaur archer drawing a bow with an arrow; readable bow and four-legged horse silhouette, clothed human torso, not a teapot icon.
10 CAPRICORN: a mythical sea-goat with a clear goat head/horns, forelegs and a curling fish tail; clearly different from Aries and Taurus.
11 AQUARIUS: a beautiful tilted amphora water vessel pouring two softly luminous flowing water streams; the vessel itself should be clearly visible, not just a zigzag line.
12 PISCES: two delicate luminous fish swimming in opposite directions in a gentle circular composition, clearly separated.
Composition: each figure occupies roughly the central 62–70% of its square cell and fits entirely within an arched UI crop; preserve at least 15% breathing room on left/right and top, avoid putting heads, horns, arrows or claws near extreme upper corners. Balance all twelve figure sizes and brightness. Keep dark blue sky visible around figures. No text, labels, letters, zodiac typographic symbols, borders, frames, architecture, castles, watermarks or UI.
This is one complete revised sprite atlas; produce exactly 12 tiles, not a contact sheet with margins.
